views.description: List of view dictionaries. Each dict can contain:

memory_efficient_inference.description: Whether to use memory-efficient inference for dense prediction heads (trades off speed). Defaults to True.

minibatch_size.description: Optional fixed minibatch size for memory-efficient inference. If provided, skips dynamic computation based on available GPU memory. Defaults to None (adaptive).

use_amp.description: Whether to use automatic mixed precision for faster inference. Defaults to True.

amp_dtype.description: The dtype to use for mixed precision. Defaults to "bf16" (bfloat16). Options: "fp16", "bf16", "fp32".

apply_mask.description: Whether to apply the non-ambiguous mask to the output. Defaults to True.

mask_edges.description: Whether to compute an edge mask based on normals and depth and apply it to the output. Defaults to True.

edge_normal_threshold.description: Tolerance threshold for normals-based edge detection. Defaults to 5.0.

edge_depth_threshold.description: Relative tolerance threshold for depth-based edge detection. Defaults to 0.03.

apply_confidence_mask.description: Whether to apply the confidence mask to the output. Defaults to False.

confidence_percentile.description: The percentile to use for the confidence threshold. Defaults to 10.
